assets.name: ffb-glyphs
assets.size: 1120 x 1080 px, 8-bit grey, no alpha (data, not artwork)
assets.layout: rows 0-1: ten digit SDF cells of 224 x 246 px (range +-4 pt); row 2 (y 492): ten 96 px cells h r star dot colon F O C U S (range +-4 pt); rows 3-4 (y 588): the digits' smooth dome fields
assets.pin_frame_matched: digits 0 and 1 and the sparkle are fitted to the pin (rectified 402 x 874): '0' = superellipse n 2.40 minus a lens, '1' = measured polygon, sparkle radial profile 15.1 / 10.3 / 6.9 pt; overlay checked at 5x
assets.gate_result: glyph outlines overlay the pin's within ~0.5 pt (see .work/flip-focus-badge/pin/glyph-overlay.png)
assets.credit: digits 2-9, h, r, F, O, C, U, S outlines from Titan One (SIL OFL 1.1, Google Fonts; TitanOne-OFL.txt), sheared 0.38 and heightened to the pin's 90.5 pt cap
